text:
olivia_pm: Quick heads-up — scheduling Olivea (Dedicated) quiet-window deploy for Tue 03:30 UTC. Need final thumbs for KV-cache priming, KMS hold, and runtime pin. Proposed bits below.

olivia_pm: Summary: Canary 10% -> full slice, model runtime pinned to rwinference-2.4.1-rc3 (commit 9f3a2b). Quiet window 03:30-03:50 UTC. Rollback window 03:50-04:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED JOB: 
```
customer: olivea
slice: olivea-dedicated-slice-7
model_runtime: rwinference-2.4.1-rc3
commit: 9f3a2b4d
canary: 2 nodes (10%)
window_start: 2026-04-07T03:30:00Z
window_end: 2026-04-07T03:50:00Z
rollback_hold_until: 2026-04-07T04:10:00Z
rollback_if: p99_latency_ms > 500 OR error_rate > 1%
kms_action: HOLD KMS-OLIV-KEY until 04:30Z
kv_priming: run prefix cache warmers pre-canary
smoke_tests: /smoke olivea-basic, /smoke kv-read, /smoke infer-latency
```

sam_ops: +1 on schedule assuming GPU reservations are locked. I requested 3x A100s for the slice — can someone confirm quota?

maria_eng: I ran the perf diff — rwinference-2.4.1-rc3 fixes KV eviction under memory pressure. Important we pin to this runtime; otherwise we'll hit premature eviction during canary. Approve pin.

lin_sre: Need to add automated rollback trigger for CPU mem spike too. Add: rollback_if: host_mem_usage > 85% for 2 min. Also we should run the smoke tests automatically post-canary before widening.

olivia_pm: Good call, lin. I'll update deploy config. Requesting KMS hold: Jake, customer has a scheduled org-level KMS rotation 03:45 UTC — can you confirm they can delay rotation until 04:30?

jake_success: Reached out to Olivea security. They can postpone rotation to 04:45 but asked for explicit confirmation that we won't touch keys in the meantime. Requesting our KMS team to ack the hold.

andre_prod: Release notes blurb ready: "Deploying rwinference-2.4.1-rc3 to Olivea dedicated slice — includes KV eviction fix and latency stability improvements. Canary + auto-rollback gating. Contact CS if you see inference regressions." OK to ship?

sam_ops: Quota confirmed — reservations locked. I patched the autoscaler pre-warm to add 20% headroom for first 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: UPDATED JOB: added host_mem rollback, smoke-tests gating.

maria_eng: Quick FYI — one non-blocking diff in the runtime telemetry naming (metrics.v2 -> metrics.v2_4) — dashboards will need a small mapping during the rollout. I'll open a tiny mapping PR but not blocking.

lin_sre: ack. I'll own the post-canary runbook: checklist includes prometheus p99, ingress error spikes, GPU mem, KV hitrate. I'll post the link in 5.

olivia_pm: Approvals: sam_ops, lin_sre, maria_eng, jake_success, andre_prod — please react with :white_check_mark: if you approve.

sam_ops: :white_check_mark:

lin_sre: :white_check_mark: (will be on-call during window)

maria_eng: :white_check_mark:

jake_success: :white_check_mark: (customer holds KMS until 04:45)

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT NOTICE: canary start scheduled at 2026-04-07T03:30:00Z. Alerts will route to #eng-oncall and #customer-success.

olivia_pm: Final note — put a safety tag on the runtime pin so any downstream automated updates skip this slice for 24h. Also please ensure rollback docs linked in runbook.

maria_eng: Done — pinned and documented in the deploy config. PR 4821 links runbook and rollback steps.

lin_sre: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/olivea-dedicated-rollout-4821 (smoke test commands included).

olivia_pm: Great. I'll kick off pre-canary cache priming 10m before start. Thanks everyone, will post a post-mortem thread if anything odd shows up.

deploy-bot: STATUS UPDATE (03:20Z): pre-canary priming started. logs: `kv-warmer: queued 120 prefixes; pushed to 2 nodes`.

sam_ops: I'll monitor capacity and be ready to scale slices if needed.

(just a reminder, thread will be used as the single source for approvals and short notes during the window)
